designationHistory.designation: Maine Acadian Culture (National Park Service partnership program)
designationHistory.indexText: Congress passed the Maine Acadian Culture Preservation Act, which created a preservation commission and let the National Park Service support Acadian sites in Maine's Saint John Valley through cooperative agreements.
designationHistory.note: This is a partnership program, not a park unit; the act did not create a park.

sources.name: 16 U.S.C. 461 notes (Cornell LII), 'Maine Acadian Culture Preservation Act'
